scripts.build: npm run build -w @aqlamna/core && npm run build -w @aqlamna/runtime
scripts.build:site: npm run build:site -w @aqlamna/editor && node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && playwright test --config site/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:colors && npm run lint:docs-arabic && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:site
scripts.lint:colors: node -e "const s=require('child_process');const r=s.execSync('grep -rn \"#[0-9a-fA-F]\\{3,8\\}\" packages/editor/src --include=\"*.tsx\" --include=\"*.ts\" --include=\"*.css\" --exclude=\"aqlamna-theme.css\" --exclude-dir=generated || true',{encoding:'utf8',shell:'pwsh.exe'});if(r.trim()){console.error(r);process.exit(1)}console.log('0 hardcoded colours')"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=aqlamna
